assessment: Proposition 6 restates and applies the misstated AKMS/Chisholm theorem, and Lemma 6.2 isolates exactly the nonuniform copy-computability condition used as its hypothesis. The PF still lacks a single uniform procedure for all copies and nevertheless concludes parameter-free \(L_{\omega_1\omega}\) \(\Sigma_1\)-definability, so the same fatal flaw is visible.
